description: NYC Department of City Planning PLUTO for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md, docs/registry/collection.md, and the review record in docs/registry/sources/ny-nyc-dcp-pluto.md.

sources.ai_use: Not addressed by the publisher; the FAQ states there are no restrictions on the use of Open Data
sources.redistribution: Permitted: 'no restrictions on the use of Open Data' (FAQ). Attribution: New York City Department of City Planning (DCP), PLUTO
sources.notes: PLUTO version 26v2, NYC Open Data dataset 64uk-42ks (858,284 lots), data last updated 2026-08-24. One SODA request with a $select of the columns the adapter reads (no owner name, no lot polygon) and a $where limited to building-class letters that can hold commercial, industrial or multifamily lots (C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, O, R, S: 245,602 lots); the adapter then keeps only lots the DOF roll (ny-nyc-dof) already holds. DCP's own copy (Bytes of the Big Apple on nyc.gov) is rendered by JavaScript and its file links could not be read; the db-pluto DigitalOcean Spaces mirror answers 403, so it was not used. data.cityofnewyork.us robots.txt: Crawl-delay 1; only /browse search pages disallowed. The Tyler/Socrata platform terms are in tension with bulk export (see ny-nyc-dof and docs/registry/requests/platform-terms/socrata.md); the agency licence is relied on.
